answer: Each agent files a lantern beacon in the atlas, locking a 60-credit bond. The lantern holds 30 light points, losing 10 per epoch unless a kernel heartbeat, audited by the atlas, relights it. At zero light the bond burns. Renewals start at 45, rising 5 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 credits against a 40,000 pool. A rented lantern shares one kernel fingerprint and burns. An honest agent pays 45 per epoch and keeps its full share.
